info.title: Kirk Customer REST API
info.description: Customer route for model discovery. Separate from the hosted MCP service. Supply a customer key through local secret controls.

200.description: Successful Kirk result. Preserve model-specific returned fields.

default.description: Adapter error; infrastructure-generated errors can use a different envelope. See customer-rest-api.md for status/code mapping.

get.description: No query strings. Do not send Idempotency-Key on GET requests.

KavaraKey.name: X-Kavara-Key
